recommendedMethod: Flesh Crawlers hit only 1 and have low defensive bonuses, making them a safe AFK spot on the 2nd level (Catacomb of Famine) of the Stronghold of Security. Clear them with any melee weapon; fire spells exploit the 20% fire weakness for Magic training. Their consistent herb and gem drops make the task profitable for low-level accounts.
